theorems.name: Submission.bv_set_lintegral_le_of_regularized_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n : ℕ) (f χ : Rn n → ℝ) (L : Set (Rn n)) (M : ℝ≥0∞), Continuous f → (∀ x, 0 ≤ f x) → Continuous χ → HasCompactSupport χ → (∀ x, 0 ≤ χ x) → IsCompact L → (∀ x ∈ L, χ x = 1) → (∀ η : ℝ, 0 < η → ENNReal.ofReal (∫ x, χ x * f x ^ 2 / Real.sqrt (f x ^ 2 + η ^ 2)) ≤ M) → ∫⁻ x in L, ENNReal.ofReal (f x) ≤ M
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
